items.title: Wells Fargo customers double their BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings to $2.35B
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses Wells Fargo's (WFC) reported holdings in BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), which doubled quarter over quarter to $2.35 billion as of June 30. With the bank's reported share count climbing 103%, Melker examines what the increase could signal about institutional demand for bitcoin (BTC-USD).

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: What Could BlackRock (BLK) Gain From A Hybrid Fund Linking ETFs And Private Assets?
items.summary: BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) has applied for regulatory approval for a new exchange traded interval fund structure that blends ETF features with private assets. The proposed hybrid vehicle would offer listed share trading while investing in private market holdings that are typically reserved for less retail access.
